About Tool Drive Offline

Tool Drive Offline is an unofficial third-party app for the Tool Drive Project. This app is not associated with or endorsed by TOOL.

Archive credits

Geordy and Karl founded the project. Drew hosted its website, and Taylor and Jon helped modernize it. Thanks to the tapers, fans who shared the drives, and setlist.fm contributors.

Project history and credits are at tooldriveproject.net/?page=about.

Visualizer credits

The kaleidoscopes were inspired by Colliding Scopes by Alan (Stereo Drift), gbendy/kaleidoscope, and Ege Çetin’s libKaleidoscope. Mirrored Stage concert photography by Originate Designs Photography.
